There are 10 Diffrent types of bridges but trains can be randomly generated from having 10 to 14 cargos.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 

Thats it, have fun. (Even though the game might be slow as hell)
